headline: AI-driven deals lift revenue but profit growth is uneven across the sector.
summary: Most majors posted double‑digit revenue growth, led by Coforge's 53.6% surge. AI services contributed strongly, especially at Infosys, LTM, HCLTech and TCS. Profit margins improved for HCLTech and TCS, while Infosys and Wipro saw modest or declining profit growth. Guidance remains cautious, with Infosys trimming FY27 growth targets.

themes.title: AI as a revenue catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related services grew sharply, boosting top‑line at several firms and supporting large‑deal wins.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins rose at HCLTech (18.2%) and TCS (24%) but remained flat or fell at others.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY, the fastest in the peer set.
Strong AI revenue ($219 m) drove 21% profit jump and margin expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit rose only 6%.
Profit fell 1.9% YoY despite 9.1% revenue growth.
